name: LAMC2
summary: LAMC2 (JEB), junctional epidermolysis bullosa, the draft-horse variant - a recessive lethal: the skin and hoof walls have nothing anchoring them and come away. A different mutation from LAMA3, so a horse can carry one and be clear of the other.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Two working copies. Nothing is wrong and nothing is passed on.

phenotypes.name: LAMC2 carrier
phenotypes.description: One copy of jeb. The horse is completely normal and there is no way to see it - but half its foals inherit the copy, and two carriers bred together are the only way junctional epidermolysis bullosa (lamc2) appears.

phenotypes.name: Junctional epidermolysis bullosa (LAMC2)
phenotypes.description: The layer that anchors skin to the body never formed. The hoof walls separate and the skin tears away wherever the foal puts weight. It does not survive.
